Definition
[Lie derivative on covector fields] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0295 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

If $\theta $ is a covector field and $X,Y$ are vector fields, then the Lie derivative of $\theta $ is given by \[ (\Lie _X \theta )(Y)=X(\theta (Y))-\theta ([X,Y]). \] Equivalently, \[ (\Lie _X \theta )(Y)=d\theta (X,Y)+Y(\theta (X)), \] where $d$ is the exterior derivative.
